# Optional external reference photos

These files remain separate from stories_transactions.csv. They are example photos, not verified Stories product photos. No photographs were generated or inserted into the transaction dataset.

Each photograph and its resized/displayed version is offered under its listed original license. The collection does not imply endorsement by the photographers or Stories.
